lane: مُسَرْهَدٌ A fat camel's hump: (S, L, K:) or a camel's hump cut in pieces. (L.) === Supplied with the comforts and conveniences of life, and well fed: and, with ة, a woman fat, and well fed. (L.) [Applied also to a young camel: see an ex. in a hemistich cited in the first paragraph of art. رجل.]
